newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Girocredit Czech unit lifts basic capital.
newsitem.headline: Girocredit Czech unit lifts basic capital.

text.p: The Czech unit of GiroCredit Bank AG der Sparkassen, said on Tuesday it had increased its basic capital by 200 million crowns to 700 million.
The bank also said in a statement that it would begin offering investment banking services in the Czech Republic in the second quarter of this year.

"The economic development of the Czech Republic over the past years indicates that the needs of our clients, in terms of the level and extent of services, are identical with the needs of clients in developed economies," the statement said.
GiroCredit opened its Czech unit, GiroCredit Sparkassen Banka Praha a.s., in 1993 with a universal banking licence.
